newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan to beef up penalties for racketeer deals-MOF.
newsitem.headline: Japan to beef up penalties for racketeer deals-MOF.

text.p: The Japanese government will aim to submit bills to strengthen punishment for deals with racketeers to the next session of parliament, Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka told a news conference on Tuesday.
He said bills to revise laws on banking and securities would be submitted to parliament this autumn if an extraordinary session is held then.
The current parliament session ends in June and the next regular session starts next January.
"We will do our best to submit such bills in the next parliament session," Mitsuzuka said.

He said the government aims to submit bills to revise laws to cope with Japan's "Big Bang" financial reforms to the next regular parliament session starting in January, after receiving proposals from three government panels due in June.
